_note: Single source for the product line. scripts/build_packaging.py renders packs, the brand book product pages and docs/product/product-line.md from this file. Formulas and percentages are indicative placeholders until the formulator and lab confirm them.

name: Daily Lotion
products.line: Oat and shea butter, for skin that stays soft till bedtime.
products.use: Smooth onto clean skin after the bath and whenever skin feels dry.
products.inci: Aqua, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Xanthan Gum, Tocopherol, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid.

name: Massage Oil
products.line: Cold-pressed coconut and almond oil for the daily maalish.
products.use: Warm a few drops between your palms. Massage in long, gentle strokes before the bath.
products.inci: Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Oil, Withania Somnifera (Ashwagandha) Root Extract, Tocopherol.
products.caution: Contains almond oil. Do not use if your baby has a nut allergy.

name: Rich Cream
products.line: Shea, oat and ceramides for dry patches and winter cheeks.
products.use: Apply a little to dry patches, cheeks and elbows, two or three times a day.
products.inci: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Squalane, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Carbomer, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.

name: Diaper Rash
Cream
products.line: Zinc oxide and calendula form a breathable barrier at every change.
products.use: Clean and dry the nappy area. Apply a thin layer at every change.
products.inci: Zinc Oxide (15%), Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Cera Alba (Beeswax), Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Lanolin, Tocopherol.

name: All-Purpose
Balm
products.line: Ghee, beeswax and kokum butter for chapped cheeks, lips, knees and cuticles.
products.use: Warm a little on your fingertip and press onto rough or chapped skin.
products.inci: Ghee (Clarified Butter), Cera Alba (Beeswax), Garcinia Indica (Kokum) Seed Butter, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Tocopherol.

name: Mineral
Sunscreen
products.line: Zinc oxide sits on the skin and reflects the sun. Broad spectrum.
products.use: For babies 6 months and older. Apply generously 15 minutes before going out. Reapply every 2 hours and after water play.
products.inci: Aqua, Zinc Oxide (non-nano, 20%), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Polyglyceryl-4 Isostearate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Magnesium Sulfate, Tocopherol, Sodium Benzoate.
products.caution: Keep babies under 6 months out of direct sun instead of using sunscreen.

name: Talc-Free
Powder
products.line: Corn starch and neem keep skin folds dry, with no talc.
products.use: Shake into your palm, away from your baby's face, then pat onto skin folds.
products.inci: Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Maranta Arundinacea (Arrowroot) Root Powder, Azadirachta Indica (Neem) Leaf Powder, Kaolin, Tocopherol.
products.caution: Keep away from the baby's face. Do not shake directly over the baby.

name: Bottle Wash
products.line: Soapnut and plant enzymes lift milk residue and rinse clean.
products.use: Pump foam onto a brush or sponge. Scrub, then rinse well under running water.
products.inci: Aqua, Sapindus Mukorossi (Soapnut) Fruit Extract, Decyl Glucoside, Coco-Glucoside, Glycerin, Protease, Amylase, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.

name: Water Wipes
products.line: 99% purified water on a plant-fibre cloth. Gentle enough for newborn faces.
products.use: Peel back the lid and pull one wipe. Close the lid firmly to keep the rest moist.
products.inci: Aqua (99%), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.
